summary.text: Bram Kleppner is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-13 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bram Kleppner was born in Washington, D.C.
Kleppner earned a high school diploma from Springbrook High School, a bachelor's degree from Middlebury College in 1987, and a graduate degree from the University of Vermont in 1999.
Kleppner's career experience includes working as a CEO and international business developer for Ben & Jerry's.
